title: Design: Inactive tag on the Part Library entry page sits before the quantity
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations: the test location and location B.
  • Have part A stocked at the test location and at location B, active here and inactive at location B.
  • Have part B stocked at the test location and at location B, tracked here and untracked at location B.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 7.2 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Part Library page.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  4. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
  5. Click the part B row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A's entry is listed.

Step 2:

  • The Parts table lists two rows, the test location and location B.
  • Location B's row shows a small grey rounded "Inactive" tag in the Remaining Quantity column, before the number.
  • The test location's row shows only the number in Remaining Quantity.

Step 3:

  • The Part Library list shows again.

Step 4:

  • Part B's entry is listed.

Step 5:

  • Location B's row shows "Not Tracked" in the Remaining Quantity column, in place of the number.
  • The test location's row shows a number in Remaining Quantity.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only)

  • S11-R8: “On a Part Library entry's detail page, the parts table shows "Not Tracked" in the Remaining Quantity column for a row whose part is untracked at its location, in place of the quantity.”
  • S11-R9: “In that table, a row whose part is inactive at its location shows the grey "Inactive" tag in the Remaining Quantity column, before the value.”
